articles.title: Salman Khan: The Uber Driver Who Won Asian Games Rowing Medal
articles.summary: Indian rower Salman Khan's inspiring journey from an Uber driver to an Asian Games bronze medallist in men's double sculls exemplifies remarkable dedication. Overcoming financial hurdles, he fulfilled his late father's dream through sport. His achievement, driven by immense discipline and perseverance, showcases how unwavering commitment leads to national pride and success, offering a powerful lesson for SSB aspirants.

articles.title: Trump hails ‘great friendship’ with Xi as Chinese leader visits White House
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping at the White House, marking their first meeting there in over a decade. The visit was characterized by significant pomp and ceremony, reflecting the high-stakes diplomatic engagement between the two global powers. This summit aimed to address key bilateral and international issues, emphasizing the importance of US-China relations despite underlying tensions.

articles.title: The next phase of Make in India
articles.summary: Launched in September 2014, India's 'Make in India' initiative aimed to boost domestic manufacturing for both national needs and global export. Over twelve years, it has significantly transformed into a comprehensive national manufacturing mission. This strategic evolution underscores India's commitment to strengthening its industrial base, fostering self-reliance, and enhancing its global economic footprint through indigenous production.

articles.title: US-India Satellite Captures Time-lapse Video of Volcanic Eruption
articles.summary: NISAR (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) data from December 2025 to August 2026 revealed the spread of lava from Russia's Krasheninnikov volcano on the Kamchatka Peninsula. This joint Earth-observing mission utilizes advanced radar to monitor geological changes like volcanic activity, providing crucial insights for disaster preparedness and understanding Earth's dynamic processes. It exemplifies international collaboration in space science.
